title: Image Typology V2 Level 1 class - Technique
description: Classification value from from Level 1 of the Image Typology V2 taxonomy. Classifies the technique of the original visual content, distinguishing photographs from all other techniques.

oneOf.title: Photograph
oneOf.description: A visual content reproduced from a photograph.

oneOf.title: Not a photograph
oneOf.description: A visual content reproduced using a technique other than photography.

oneOf.title: Undetermined
oneOf.description: The classification could not be determined, or does not apply at this level.
